parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment identifies a specific weakness: the proposed pixel loss is not novel because it essentially applies reconstruction/MSE loss at different levels of a refine LSTM cell, and the Area loss forces motion dynamics, which is conceptually similar to motion modeling in a cited paper. It provides a justification by pointing out the similarity and naming the relevant work. However, this feedback is only minimally actionable: the comment merely asserts a lack of novelty and cites a related paper without offering any concrete guidance on how to improve the draft, such as which experiments to add or how to reframe the contribution. The authors are left to figure out on their own how to respond. Moreover, the comment does not provide clear and constructive suggestions; it only briefly notes the similarity to prior work without proposing ways to differentiate the work or discussing unique aspects. Since it identifies a weakness but is vague and offers minimal improvement guidance, lacking depth and detailed direction, it aligns with the lower end of the rubric rather than the level requiring clear and actionable feedback.
